periods.label: Hephaestus accompanies Hestia at Denatus

appearance.overview: A beautiful red-haired goddess in light top and black trousers, with an eyepatch over the right eye.

personality.summary: Experienced, pragmatic, and supportive; she warns Hestia not to rely on her influence and explains the ugly reality of Denatus naming customs.
flaws: limited ability to intervene under majority rules
personality.inner_conflict: She sympathizes with Hestia but cannot control the meeting for her.

decision_pattern.advice: States constraints plainly and helps Hestia interpret Denatus behavior.

quote_samples: 在多数决的规定前，我的意见也不过就是一票罢了。

mannerisms: looks into the distance when recalling naming trauma
habits.daily_routine: Attends Denatus as an established major-familia deity.

background.pre_story: Close friend and former host of Hestia.

relationships.hestia: Close friend she advises and sits beside at Denatus.
relationships.bell-cranel: Indirect beneficiary of her friendship with Hestia.

knowledge: Knows Denatus titles often become embarrassing
Knows Hestia's vote alone has little weight
periods.summary: Hephaestus sits beside Hestia, explains that she cannot guarantee a good title under majority rule, and helps frame Denatus as a cruel naming arena rather than the noble meeting Bell imagines.

key_events.summary: Hephaestus supports Hestia through the naming ceremony and explains its dangers.
